title: recipe/job-progress - determinate progress for long-running background work

review.applied: component/btn ingredient added for the retry action (req 1); 're-run a failed background job' need added (req 2); queued/done constraint added + announcement mechanism named (req 3); convergence criterion rewritten (req 4)

problem: The multi-state jobs surface (progress bar + state + scanned/total + stalled/failed + retry, live-updating) was rebuilt identically in 3 runs as improvisation; no sanctioned composition exists.
evidence: 3 runs composed .progress + badge + text + stall detection under fallback/plain-content (G-02)
c1 prop component/job-progress and c3 prop recipe/job-status requested the arrangement
why_insufficient: Pieces exist but the composition contract (states, stall detection, retry, aria semantics) does not; without it the answer stays FALLBACK.

curation_recipe.title: Long-running background work shows determinate progress
curation_recipe.summary: Compose the progress bar with a state badge, a scanned/total readout and text for queued/running/stalled/failed/done; failures name the reason and offer retry; updates arrive by JSON polling.
needs: show the progress of a background job
determinate progress for a long-running operation
show how far a scan has come
background job status with percent complete
constraints: queued and done are labelled states too (same text+colour treatment; a completed bar is not left unlabelled)
stalled is detected by the count not advancing and shown as a text label
failed names the reason and offers a retry action
aria-valuenow updates on the bar; state changes are announced via an aria-live region on the status line (or the shared toast host)

evidence.quote: Fallback/local solution used: fallback/plain-content in all three - composing .progress + .spinner + .badge on a system card, plus JSON polling and stall detection

compatibility: Additive; the existing status-with-text recipe is referenced, not modified.

validation.g02_mapping: 5 x COMPOSE recipe/job-progress (#1,#3,#4,#6,#7) + 2 x RESOLVED component/progress (#2, #5); zero FALLBACK / UNDEFINED / stray COMPOSE
validation.non_regression: spinner queries unchanged; 'show the state of an item' still status-with-text

migration: The c1/c3/c4 jobs pages become direct citations; the TODO(authority-undefined) markers can be replaced with the recipe citation.
